```{r classified by whether it changes or not during event}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 9
# Ordered deviation heatmap: consensus column FIRST + one column per kept event.
# Cells now reflect sensor behaviour during each event:
#   * changed state (activated)      -> coloured by rank - consensus rank
#   * no change, stayed flowing      -> solid green
#   * no change, stayed dry          -> solid orange (the true gaps in a partial seq.)
#   * no observations / not deployed -> medium-dark grey
# Events with data for < half the deployed sensors are dropped; `drop_events`
# removes specific events. Sized for an 8.5x11 page (<=6.5 in, all text >=10 pt).

dev_heatmap_data <- function(consensus, event_seqs, input, event_df, ids, shed,
                             drop_events = NULL){
  ev_obs <- input %>% filter(ID %in% ids) %>%
    inner_join(event_df %>% select(datetime, event_id, event_type), by = "datetime") %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_id), event_type != "baseflow")

  data_counts <- ev_obs %>% group_by(event_id) %>%
    summarise(n_with_data = n_distinct(ID), .groups = "drop")
  keep_events <- data_counts %>%
    filter(n_with_data >= length(ids) / 2) %>% pull(event_id)
  keep_events <- setdiff(keep_events, drop_events)
  message(shed, ": ", length(keep_events), " events kept; dropped manually: ",
          paste(drop_events, collapse = ", "))

  # per (event, node) state: did it change, stay wet, or stay dry?
  states <- ev_obs %>% filter(event_id %in% keep_events) %>%
    group_by(event_id, ID) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), n_wet = sum(binary == 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(state = case_when(n_wet == 0 ~ "always_dry",
                             n_wet == n ~ "always_wet",
                             TRUE       ~ "changed"))

  ref     <- consensus %>% transmute(ID, ref_rank = sequence)
  ev_rank <- event_seqs %>% filter(event_id %in% keep_events) %>%
    transmute(event_id, ID, rank = as.numeric(Sequence))

  ev <- states %>%
    left_join(ev_rank, by = c("event_id", "ID")) %>%
    transmute(col = paste0("E", event_id), ord = as.numeric(event_id), ID, rank, state)
  cons <- ref %>% transmute(col = "Consensus", ord = -Inf, ID,
                            rank = as.numeric(ref_rank), state = "changed")

  bind_rows(cons, ev) %>%
    complete(nesting(col, ord), ID) %>%             # unobserved cells -> NA
    left_join(ref, by = "ID") %>%
    mutate(dev   = rank - ref_rank,
           state = ifelse(is.na(state), "no_data", state),
           shed  = shed)
}

plot_dev_heatmap <- function(d, shed){
  ref_order  <- d %>% filter(col == "Consensus") %>% arrange(ref_rank) %>%
    pull(ID) %>% unique() %>% as.character()
  event_cols <- d %>% filter(col != "Consensus") %>% distinct(col, ord) %>%
    arrange(ord) %>% pull(col)
  col_order  <- c("Consensus", event_cols)

  d <- d %>% mutate(ID = factor(as.character(ID), levels = ref_order))
  d_changed <- filter(d, state == "changed")
  d_cat     <- filter(d, state != "changed")

  state_cols <- c(always_wet = "grey5", always_dry = "#DB995A", no_data = "grey40")
  state_labs <- c(always_wet = "No change: flowing",
                  always_dry = "No change: dry",
                  no_data    = "No data")

  ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = d_cat, aes(col, ID, fill = state), color = "white") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols, labels = state_labs,
                      breaks = c("always_wet", "always_dry", "no_data"),
                      name = "Sensor state", drop = FALSE) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_tile(data = d_changed, aes(col, ID, fill = dev), color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#B2182B", mid = "grey95", high = "#2166AC",
                         midpoint = 0, name = "rank −\nconsensus") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = col_order) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Node (consensus order; wets first at bottom)", title = shed) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid   = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
          axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.title   = element_text(size = 11),
          plot.title   = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 10))
}

h_w3 <- plot_dev_heatmap(dev_heatmap_data(avg_event_w3, event_seqsW3, input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, "W3"), "W3")
h_fb <- plot_dev_heatmap(dev_heatmap_data(avg_event_fb, event_seqsFB, input_fb, FBall_events, FB_IDs, "FB"), "FB")
h_zz <- plot_dev_heatmap(dev_heatmap_data(avg_event_zz, event_seqsZZ, input_zz, ZZall_events, ZZ_IDs, "ZZ",
                                          drop_events = c(9, 14)), "ZZ")

figure3 <- (h_w3 / h_fb / h_zz) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = "Coloured cells = sensor activated (rank vs. consensus). Green = stayed flowing, orange = stayed dry (a gap in the partial sequence), grey = no data.",
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 10)))
figure3
ggsave("figure3_deviation_heatmap.pdf", figure3, width = 6.5, height = 9)
```

New Version, comparing all sequences, differentiating between wetting and drying, and showing only 2 for each watershed
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9
# One event per watershed. Y-axis = that event's OBSERVED order (wetting; drying
# reversed so 1 = dries last). Columns = each TEST sequence (Flow Persistence,
# TWI, Consensus) compared to the observed WETTING and DRYING order.
# Cell colour = test rank - observed rank, BOTH re-ranked on their shared nodes.

# >>> pick ONE event per watershed to display <
pick_event <- list(W3 = 12, FB = 14, ZZ = 8)

# ---- print the eligible (kept) events from the earlier curation -------------
wetting_eligible <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$drying_only)))
drying_eligible  <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$wetting_only)))
keep_trans <- list(
  W3 = events_with_transitions(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, 5),
  FB = events_with_transitions(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, 5),
  ZZ = events_with_transitions(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, 5))
keep_both <- Map(function(s, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(s$remove, s$wetting_only, s$drying_only))),
                 dir_spec, universe)
keep_both <- Map(intersect, keep_both, keep_trans)
for (s in names(keep_both))
  message(s, " events with BOTH valid wetting & drying (choose from these): ",
          paste(keep_both[[s]], collapse = ", "))

# ---- observed ranks for one event (wetting; drying reversed) ----------------
obs_rank <- function(dir_long, e, reverse = FALSE){
  r <- dir_long %>% filter(event_id == e) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% select(ID = sensor_id, rank)
  if (reverse && nrow(r) > 0) r <- r %>% mutate(rank = max(rank) - rank + 1)
  r
}

# ---- build deviation data for one watershed's chosen event ------------------
# Both the observed order and the test sequence are RE-RANKED on their shared
# nodes (1..k) before differencing, so dev reflects relative position only.
test_vs_event_data <- function(models, ds, e, shed){
  obs_wet <- obs_rank(ds$wetting, e)                  # 1 = wets first
  obs_dry <- obs_rank(ds$drying,  e, reverse = TRUE)  # 1 = dries last
  refs <- list(wet = obs_wet, dry = obs_dry)

  dev_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(models, function(mseq, mname){
    ms <- mseq %>% transmute(ID, mrank = sequence)
    purrr::imap_dfr(refs, function(obs, dir){
      obs %>% inner_join(ms, by = "ID") %>%
        mutate(obs_r  = rank(rank,  ties.method = "first"),   # re-rank on shared set
               test_r = rank(mrank, ties.method = "first")) %>%
        transmute(ID, dev = test_r - obs_r,
                  col = paste0(mname, "\n", ifelse(dir == "wet", "wetting", "drying")),
                  ord = match(mname, names(models)) * 2 - (dir == "wet"))
    })
  })

  # y-axis order = this event's observed wetting order, re-ranked 1..k ---------
  yaxis <- obs_wet %>% mutate(obs_rank = rank(rank, ties.method = "first")) %>%
    select(ID, obs_rank)

  dev_df %>% left_join(yaxis, by = "ID") %>%
    mutate(shed = shed, event = e)
}

plot_test_vs_event <- function(d, shed, e){
  ref_order <- d %>% distinct(ID, obs_rank) %>% arrange(obs_rank) %>%
    pull(ID) %>% as.character()
  col_order <- d %>% distinct(col, ord) %>% arrange(ord) %>% pull(col)
  d <- d %>% mutate(ID = factor(as.character(ID), levels = ref_order),
                    col = factor(col, levels = col_order))
  ggplot(d, aes(col, ID, fill = dev)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey95", high = "#B2182B",
                         midpoint = 0, name = "test −\nobserved") +
    labs(x = "", y = "Node (observed wetting order; wets first at bottom)",
         title = paste0(shed, " — event ", e)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 10))
}

models_w3 <- list("Flow Persistence" = W3_pk_seq, "TWI" = w3_twi_sequence, "Consensus" = avg_event_w3)
models_fb <- list("Flow Persistence" = FB_pk_seq, "TWI" = fb_twi_sequence, "Consensus" = avg_event_fb)
models_zz <- list("Flow Persistence" = ZZ_pk_seq, "TWI" = zz_twi_sequence, "Consensus" = avg_event_zz)

h_fb <- plot_test_vs_event(test_vs_event_data(models_fb, ds_fb, pick_event$FB, "FB"), "FB", pick_event$FB)
h_zz <- plot_test_vs_event(test_vs_event_data(models_zz, ds_zz, pick_event$ZZ, "ZZ"), "ZZ", pick_event$ZZ)

figure3 <- (h_w3 / h_fb / h_zz) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = "Each panel: one event. Columns = test sequences (Flow Persistence, TWI, Consensus) vs. that event's observed wetting and (reversed) drying order, both re-ranked on shared nodes. Colour = test rank minus observed rank; grey = agreement, blue = test places node earlier, red = later.",
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 9)))
figure3
ggsave("figure3_test_vs_event_heatmap.pdf", figure3, width = 8, height = 9)
```

Version with slightly different symbology:
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9
# One event per watershed. Y-axis = that event's OBSERVED order (wetting; drying
# reversed so 1 = dries last). Columns = each TEST sequence vs. observed wetting
# and drying order, re-ranked on shared nodes.
# Fill = |test rank - observed rank| on a black->white greyscale (black = exact
# agreement). Direction shown by a texture overlay:
#   diagonal "/"  = test ranks the node LATER than observed (test_r > obs_r)
#   diagonal "\"  = test ranks the node EARLIER than observed (test_r < obs_r)
#   (no line)     = exact agreement (dev = 0)

# >>> pick ONE event per watershed to display <
pick_event <- list(W3 = 12, FB = 14, ZZ = 8)

# ---- print the eligible (kept) events from the earlier curation -------------
wetting_eligible <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$drying_only)))
drying_eligible  <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$wetting_only)))
keep_trans <- list(
  W3 = events_with_transitions(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, 5),
  FB = events_with_transitions(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, 5),
  ZZ = events_with_transitions(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, 5))
keep_both <- Map(function(s, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(s$remove, s$wetting_only, s$drying_only))),
                 dir_spec, universe)
keep_both <- Map(intersect, keep_both, keep_trans)
for (s in names(keep_both))
  message(s, " events with BOTH valid wetting & drying (choose from these): ",
          paste(keep_both[[s]], collapse = ", "))

# ---- observed ranks for one event (wetting; drying reversed) ----------------
obs_rank <- function(dir_long, e, reverse = FALSE){
  r <- dir_long %>% filter(event_id == e) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% select(ID = sensor_id, rank)
  if (reverse && nrow(r) > 0) r <- r %>% mutate(rank = max(rank) - rank + 1)
  r
}

# ---- deviation data; both sequences re-ranked on shared nodes ---------------
test_vs_event_data <- function(models, ds, e, shed){
  obs_wet <- obs_rank(ds$wetting, e)                  # 1 = wets first
  obs_dry <- obs_rank(ds$drying,  e, reverse = TRUE)  # 1 = dries last
  refs <- list(wet = obs_wet, dry = obs_dry)

  dev_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(models, function(mseq, mname){
    ms <- mseq %>% transmute(ID, mrank = sequence)
    purrr::imap_dfr(refs, function(obs, dir){
      obs %>% inner_join(ms, by = "ID") %>%
        mutate(obs_r  = rank(rank,  ties.method = "first"),
               test_r = rank(mrank, ties.method = "first")) %>%
        transmute(ID,
                  dev     = test_r - obs_r,
                  abs_dev = abs(test_r - obs_r),
                  dirn    = dplyr::case_when(dev > 0 ~ "later",
                                             dev < 0 ~ "earlier",
                                             TRUE    ~ "equal"),
                  col = paste0(mname, "\n", ifelse(dir == "wet", "wetting", "drying")),
                  ord = match(mname, names(models)) * 2 - (dir == "wet"))
    })
  })

  yaxis <- obs_wet %>% mutate(obs_rank = rank(rank, ties.method = "first")) %>%
    select(ID, obs_rank)
  dev_df %>% left_join(yaxis, by = "ID") %>% mutate(shed = shed, event = e)
}

# ---- plot: greyscale |dev| fill + diagonal line texture for direction -------
plot_test_vs_event <- function(d, shed, e){
  ref_order <- d %>% distinct(ID, obs_rank) %>% arrange(obs_rank) %>%
    pull(ID) %>% as.character()
  col_order <- d %>% distinct(col, ord) %>% arrange(ord) %>% pull(col)
  d <- d %>% mutate(ID  = factor(as.character(ID), levels = ref_order),
                    colf = factor(col, levels = col_order),
                    x    = as.integer(colf),
                    y    = as.integer(ID))

  seg <- d %>% filter(dirn != "equal") %>%
    mutate(x0 = x - 0.45, x1 = x + 0.45,
           # "/" for later (bottom-left to top-right), "\" for earlier
           y0 = ifelse(dirn == "later", y - 0.45, y + 0.45),
           y1 = ifelse(dirn == "later", y + 0.45, y - 0.45))

  ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = abs_dev), colour = "grey85") +
    geom_segment(data = seg, aes(x = x0, xend = x1, y = y0, yend = y1),
                 colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "black", high = "white", name = "|test −\nobserved|",
                        limits = c(0, max(d$abs_dev, na.rm = TRUE))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(col_order), labels = col_order,
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(ref_order), labels = ref_order,
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Node (observed wetting order; wets first at bottom)",
         title = paste0(shed, " — event ", e)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 10))
}

    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 9)))
```

```{r fig4-wetting-drying}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
# RQ2. Wetting order on x, drying order on y with the y-axis FLIPPED, so the
# dashed line (bottom-left to top-right) marks the case where the drying order
# is the exact REVERSE of the wetting order (wets first => dries last). Points
# near that line => reversible "fill-and-spill" behaviour; points near a normal
# 1:1 (top-left to bottom-right) => wets and dries in the same order.

direction_sequences <- function(input, event_df, ids){
  dat <- input %>% filter(ID %in% ids) %>%
    inner_join(event_df %>% select(datetime, event_id, event_type), by = "datetime") %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_id), event_type != "baseflow")
  wet_out <- NULL; dry_out <- NULL
  for (ev in unique(dat$event_id)){
    e <- dat %>% filter(event_id == ev)
    counts <- e %>% group_by(datetime) %>% summarise(nw = sum(binary == 1), .groups = "drop")
    peak_t <- counts$datetime[which.max(counts$nw)]
    w <- e %>% filter(datetime <= peak_t, binary == 1) %>%
      group_by(ID) %>% summarise(t = min(datetime), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(t)
    d <- e %>% filter(datetime >= peak_t, binary == 1) %>%
      group_by(ID) %>% summarise(t = max(datetime), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(t)
    if (nrow(w) >= 2) wet_out <- bind_rows(wet_out, tibble(event_id = ev, sensor_id = w$ID))
    if (nrow(d) >= 2) dry_out <- bind_rows(dry_out, tibble(event_id = ev, sensor_id = d$ID))
  }
  list(wetting = wet_out, drying = dry_out)
}
cons_dir <- function(df){
  cs <- as.numeric(average_activation_sequence(as.data.frame(df))$consensus_sequence)
  tibble(ID = cs, sequence = seq_along(cs))
}
ds_w3 <- direction_sequences(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs)
ds_fb <- direction_sequences(input_fb, FBall_events, FB_IDs)
ds_zz <- direction_sequences(input_zz, ZZall_events, ZZ_IDs)
wet_w3 <- cons_dir(ds_w3$wetting); dry_w3 <- cons_dir(ds_w3$drying)
wet_fb <- cons_dir(ds_fb$wetting); dry_fb <- cons_dir(ds_fb$drying)
wet_zz <- cons_dir(ds_zz$wetting); dry_zz <- cons_dir(ds_zz$drying)

wd_rr <- function(wet, dry, shed) wet %>% transmute(ID, wet_rank = sequence) %>%
  inner_join(dry %>% transmute(ID, dry_rank = sequence), by = "ID") %>% mutate(shed = shed)
wd_all <- bind_rows(wd_rr(wet_w3, dry_w3, "W3"),
                    wd_rr(wet_fb, dry_fb, "FB"),
                    wd_rr(wet_zz, dry_zz, "ZZ")) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")))

seg_df <- wd_all %>% group_by(shed) %>%
  summarise(n = max(c(wet_rank, dry_rank)), .groups = "drop")
tau_df <- wd_all %>% group_by(shed) %>%
  summarise(tau = cor(wet_rank, dry_rank, method = "kendall"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lab = paste0("tau = ", round(tau, 2)))

figure4 <- ggplot(wd_all, aes(wet_rank, dry_rank)) +
  geom_segment(data = seg_df, aes(x = 1, y = n, xend = n, yend = 1),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ID), color = "white", size = 2) +
  geom_text(data = tau_df, aes(-Inf, -Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = -0.2, 
            vjust = 2, 
            size = 3) +
  scale_y_reverse() + 
  scale_color_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ shed, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Wetting order (1 = wets first)",
       y = "Drying order (1 = dries first, reverse of wetting sequence)",
       title = "Wetting vs. drying sequence (dashed = drying is the reverse of wetting)") +
  theme_bw() + theme(strip.background = element_blank())
figure4
ggsave("figure4_wetting_vs_drying.pdf", figure4, width = 6, height = 3, units = "in")
```

# Figure 6 — How different are Flow Persistence & TWI from the event sequence?

```{r fig6-rank-rank}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 10
# RQ3. Rank-rank agreement of each TEST sequence (Flow Persistence, TWI) against
# the EVENT-based (observed) sequence. On the dashed 1:1 line = agreement. Points
# coloured by signed rank deviation with a high-contrast diverging scale. No BFS.

rr_vs_event <- function(consensus, fp, twi, shed){
  ref <- consensus %>% transmute(ID, ref_rank = sequence)
  bind_rows(fp  %>% transmute(ID, rank = sequence, method = "Flow Persistence"),
            twi %>% transmute(ID, rank = sequence, method = "TWI")) %>%
    inner_join(ref, by = "ID") %>% mutate(dev = rank - ref_rank, shed = shed)
}
rr_all <- bind_rows(
  rr_vs_event(avg_event_w3, W3_pk_seq, w3_twi_sequence, "W3"),
  rr_vs_event(avg_event_fb, FB_pk_seq, fb_twi_sequence, "FB"),
  rr_vs_event(avg_event_zz, ZZ_pk_seq, zz_twi_sequence, "ZZ")) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")))

tau_rr <- rr_all %>% group_by(shed, method) %>%
  summarise(tau = cor(rank, ref_rank, method = "kendall"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lab = paste0("tau = ", round(tau, 2)))
# updated tau calculation, with p-value
# small p-value means significantly associated
tau_rr <- rr_all %>% group_by(shed, method) %>%
  summarise(ct = list(cor.test(rank, ref_rank, method = "kendall")), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(tau = map_dbl(ct, "estimate"),
         p   = map_dbl(ct, "p.value"),
         lab = paste0("tau = ", round(tau, 2),
                      "\np = ", format.pval(p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3))) %>%
  select(shed, method, lab)

dmax <- max(abs(rr_all$dev), na.rm = TRUE)
figure6 <- ggplot(rr_all, aes(ref_rank, rank)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(color = dev), size = 4, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ID), color = "white", size = 2) +
  geom_text(data = tau_rr, aes(-Inf, Inf, label = lab),
            hjust = -0.15, vjust = 1.6, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # scale_color_gradientn(
  #   colours = c("#00429d", "#4771b2", "#73a2c6", "grey88", "#f4777f", "#cf3759", "#93003a"),
  #   limits = c(-dmax, dmax), name = "rank −\nevent") +
  facet_grid(shed ~ method, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Event-based rank (1 = wets first)", y = "Predicted rank",
       title = "Test sequences vs. the event-based sequence") +
  theme_bw() + theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
                     text = element_text(size = 12))
figure6
ggsave("figure6_rank_rank.pdf", figure6, width = 6.5, units = "in")
```

# Figure 7 — Flow Persistence vs. TWI accuracy through time (events only)

```{r fig7-accuracy-time}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 12
# RQ3. For each watershed: backdrop cropped to the two STIC seasons (no winter
# gap), grey bands = identified events, point at each EVENT timestep coloured by
# whether Flow Persistence or TWI is more accurate (or a tie). All rows share the
# SAME season x-limits (anchored to W3) so 2024 ends in July for every panel.
fp_twi_cols <- c("Flow Persistence" = "#7ebdc2",
                 "TWI"              = "#f3dfa2",
                 "Tie"              = "gray10")

# shared season windows, anchored to the W3 record ----------------------------
w3_2024_end <- max(filter(w3_q_seasonal, datetime >= start24)$datetime)
season_lims <- tibble(
  season = c("Summer 2023", "Summer 2024"),
  xmin   = c(start_23, start24),
  xmax   = c(stop_23,  w3_2024_end))

clip_seasons <- function(df) df %>% add_season() %>%
  left_join(season_lims, by = "season") %>%
  filter(datetime >= xmin, datetime <= xmax) %>%
  select(-xmin, -xmax)

# event bands, tagged by season and clipped to the shared windows -------------
season_bands <- function(event_df) event_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(event_id)) %>%
  group_by(event_id) %>%
  summarise(xmin = min(datetime), xmax = max(datetime), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(season = if_else(xmax <= stop_23, "Summer 2023", "Summer 2024")) %>%
  left_join(season_lims, by = "season", suffix = c("", "_lim")) %>%
  filter(xmax >= xmin_lim, xmin <= xmax_lim) %>%
  mutate(xmin = pmax(xmin, xmin_lim), xmax = pmin(xmax, xmax_lim)) %>%
  select(event_id, xmin, xmax, season)

# winner points (FP vs TWI, or tie) at event timesteps ------------------------
winner_pts <- function(df_long, event_df, backdrop, ycol){
  df_long %>%
    filter(model %in% c("pk_accuracy", "twi_accuracy")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = accuracy) %>%
    filter(datetime %in% event_dt(event_df)) %>%
    mutate(winner = case_when(pk_accuracy  > twi_accuracy ~ "Flow Persistence",
                              twi_accuracy > pk_accuracy  ~ "TWI",
                              TRUE                          ~ "Tie"),
           winner = factor(winner, levels = c("Flow Persistence", "TWI", "Tie"))) %>%
    inner_join(backdrop %>% select(datetime, all_of(ycol)), by = "datetime") %>%
    clip_seasons()
}

# one watershed row -----------------------------------------------------------
fig7_panel <- function(backdrop, bands_df, pts, ycol, ylab, show_strip = TRUE){
  ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = bands_df, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
              fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(data = backdrop, aes(datetime, .data[[ycol]]),
              color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = pts, aes(datetime, .data[[ycol]], color = winner), size = 0.5) +
    geom_blank(data = season_lims, aes(x = xmin)) +
    geom_blank(data = season_lims, aes(x = xmax)) +
    facet_wrap(~ season, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = fp_twi_cols, name = "More accurate", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%b", date_breaks = "1 month", timezone = "UTC") +
    labs(x = "", y = ylab) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = if (show_strip) element_text() else element_blank(),
          legend.position = "right",
          text = element_text(size = 12))
}

# backdrops (clipped to shared season windows) --------------------------------
w3_backdrop <- clip_seasons(w3_q_seasonal)
fb_backdrop <- clip_seasons(FBall_events %>% select(datetime, roll_mean))
zz_backdrop <- clip_seasons(ZZall_events %>% select(datetime, roll_mean))

p_w3 <- fig7_panel(w3_backdrop, season_bands(w3_events_all),
                   winner_pts(df_long_w3, w3_events_all, w3_q_seasonal, "Q_mm_day"),
                   "Q_mm_day", "W3 discharge (mm/day)", show_strip = TRUE)
p_fb <- fig7_panel(fb_backdrop, season_bands(FBall_events),
                   winner_pts(df_long_fb, FBall_events, FBall_events, "roll_mean"),
                   "roll_mean", "FB stage (cm)", show_strip = FALSE)
p_zz <- fig7_panel(zz_backdrop, season_bands(ZZall_events),
                   winner_pts(df_long_zz, ZZall_events, ZZall_events, "roll_mean"),
                   "roll_mean", "ZZ stage (cm)", show_strip = FALSE)

figure7 <- p_w3 / p_fb / p_zz + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
figure7
ggsave("figure7_accuracy_time.pdf", figure7, width = 6.5, units = "in")
```

# Figure 8 — Maps of node-level model accuracy (Flow Persistence & TWI)

```{r fig8-accuracy-maps}
#| message: false

# Per-node accuracy over the whole record, Flow Persistence (pk) and TWI only.
# Rotated for display, greyscale points, one row per watershed faceted by model.
comparison_w3 <- w3_mod$comparison
comparison_fb <- fb_mod$comparison
comparison_zz <- zz_mod$comparison

id_accuracy <- function(comparison){
  comparison %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    summarize(total        = n(),
              pk_accuracy  = sum(pk_eval  == "correct") / total,
              twi_accuracy = sum(twi_eval == "correct") / total,
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    select(ID, pk_accuracy, twi_accuracy) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(pk_accuracy, twi_accuracy),
                 names_to = "model", values_to = "accuracy") %>%
    mutate(model = case_when(
             model == "pk_accuracy"  ~ "Flow Persistence",
             model == "twi_accuracy" ~ "Topographic Wetness Index"),
           model = fct_relevel(model, c("Flow Persistence",
                                        "Topographic Wetness Index")))
}
```

```{r fig8-accuracy-maps}
              twi_accuracy = sum(twi_eval == "correct") / total,

    select(ID, pk_accuracy, twi_accuracy) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(pk_accuracy, twi_accuracy),
                 names_to = "model", values_to = "accuracy") %>%
    mutate(model = case_when(
             model == "pk_accuracy"  ~ "Flow Persistence",
             model == "twi_accuracy" ~ "Topographic Wetness Index (TWI)"),
           model = fct_relevel(model, c("Flow Persistence",
                                        "Topographic Wetness Index (TWI)")))
}
```

# Table
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Accuracy of the Flow Persistence (pk) and TWI sequences DURING EVENTS ONLY.
# Predictions come from the existing comparison tables (calc_model_result output);
# here we simply evaluate them on event timesteps and split by hydrograph limb.
# Positive class = "flowing" (1), so Sensitivity = correctly predicted flowing,
# Specificity = correctly predicted dry.

event_metrics <- function(comparison, event_df, shed){
  dat <- comparison %>%
    select(datetime, ID, binary, pk, twi) %>%
    inner_join(event_df %>% select(datetime, event_id, event_type) %>% distinct(),
               by = "datetime") %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_id), event_type != "baseflow") %>%
    pivot_longer(c(pk, twi), names_to = "method", values_to = "pred") %>%
    mutate(method = recode(method,
                           pk  = "Flow Persistence",
                           twi = "Topographic Wetness Index"))

  comp_all  <- dat %>% mutate(component = "All event time")
  comp_limb <- dat %>% filter(event_type %in% c("rising", "falling")) %>%
    mutate(component = if_else(event_type == "rising", "Rising limb", "Falling limb"))

  bind_rows(comp_all, comp_limb) %>%
    group_by(shed = shed, method, component) %>%
    summarise(n  = n(),
              tp = sum(pred == 1 & binary == 1),
              tn = sum(pred == 0 & binary == 0),
              fp = sum(pred == 1 & binary == 0),
              fn = sum(pred == 0 & binary == 1),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Accuracy    = (tp + tn) / n,
           Sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn),
           Specificity = tn / (tn + fp)) %>%
    select(shed, method, component, n, Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity)
}

event_accuracy <- bind_rows(
  event_metrics(w3_mod$comparison, w3_events_all, "W3"),
  event_metrics(fb_mod$comparison, FBall_events,  "FB"),
  event_metrics(zz_mod$comparison, ZZall_events,  "ZZ")
) %>%
  mutate(component = factor(component,
                    levels = c("All event time", "Rising limb", "Falling limb")),
         method = factor(method,
                    levels = c("Flow Persistence", "Topographic Wetness Index")),
         shed   = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ"))) %>%
  arrange(shed, method, component)

# nicely formatted table (percentages, 1 decimal) -----------------------------
event_accuracy_fmt <- event_accuracy %>%
  mutate(across(c(Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity), ~ round(. * 100, 1)))

knitr::kable(
  event_accuracy_fmt,
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Sequence", "Hydrograph component", "n",
                "Accuracy (%)", "Sensitivity (%)", "Specificity (%)"),
  align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Predictive accuracy of the Flow Persistence and TWI sequences during events only, reported overall (all event timesteps) and separately for the rising and falling limbs. Positive class = flowing: Sensitivity = fraction of flowing observations correctly predicted, Specificity = fraction of dry observations correctly predicted."
)
```
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Accuracy of the Flow Persistence (pk) and TWI sequences at predicting the
# observed wet/dry pattern, split into WETTING vs DRYING and SUMMARIZED ACROSS
# EVENTS. Wetting = timesteps up to and including each event's peak network
# extent (most flowing nodes); drying = after the peak. Counts are pooled over
# events, so metrics are observation-weighted. Positive class = flowing (1):
# Sensitivity = flowing correctly predicted, Specificity = dry correctly predicted.

event_dir_metrics <- function(comparison, event_df, shed){
  dat <- comparison %>%
    select(datetime, ID, binary, pk, twi) %>%
    inner_join(event_df %>% select(datetime, event_id) %>% distinct(),
               by = "datetime") %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_id))

  peaks <- dat %>%
    group_by(event_id, datetime) %>%
    summarise(nwet = sum(binary == 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(event_id) %>%
    slice_max(nwet, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(event_id, peak_t = datetime)

  dat %>%
    left_join(peaks, by = "event_id") %>%
    mutate(direction = if_else(datetime <= peak_t, "Wetting", "Drying")) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(pk, twi), names_to = "method", values_to = "pred") %>%
    mutate(method = recode(method,
                           pk  = "Flow Persistence",
                           twi = "Topographic Wetness Index")) %>%
    group_by(shed = shed, event_id, method, direction) %>%
    summarise(tp = sum(pred == 1 & binary == 1),
              tn = sum(pred == 0 & binary == 0),
              fp = sum(pred == 1 & binary == 0),
              fn = sum(pred == 0 & binary == 1),
              .groups = "drop")
}

# pool the per-event counts across events -------------------------------------
direction_summary <- bind_rows(
  event_dir_metrics(w3_mod$comparison, w3_events_all, "W3"),
  event_dir_metrics(fb_mod$comparison, FBall_events,  "FB"),
  event_dir_metrics(zz_mod$comparison, ZZall_events,  "ZZ")
) %>%
  group_by(shed, method, direction) %>%
  summarise(n_events = n_distinct(event_id),
            tp = sum(tp), tn = sum(tn), fp = sum(fp), fn = sum(fn),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(n           = tp + tn + fp + fn,
         Accuracy    = (tp + tn) / n,
         Sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn),
         Specificity = tn / (tn + fp),
         shed      = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         method    = factor(method, levels = c("Flow Persistence",
                                               "Topographic Wetness Index")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying"))) %>%
  arrange(shed, method, direction) %>%
  select(shed, method, direction, n_events, n, Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity)

# nicely formatted table (percentages, 1 decimal) -----------------------------
direction_summary_fmt <- direction_summary %>%
  mutate(across(c(Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity), ~ round(. * 100, 1)))

knitr::kable(
  direction_summary_fmt,
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Sequence", "Direction", "Events", "n",
                "Accuracy (%)", "Sensitivity (%)", "Specificity (%)"),
  align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Predictive accuracy of the Flow Persistence and TWI sequences during events, split into wetting (up to peak network extent) and drying (after peak) phases and summarized across all events. Counts are pooled over events (observation-weighted). Positive class = flowing: Sensitivity = fraction of flowing observations correctly predicted; Specificity = fraction of dry observations correctly predicted."
)


```

# 8-27-26 added thing
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# All-pairs comparison of per-event WETTING and DRYING sequences within each
# watershed. For every unordered pair of events (i, j) that share >= 3 nodes,
# compute Kendall's tau and Pearson's r between the two nodes' ranks. Then
# summarise how tau and r agree.
#
# Per-event direction sequences come from direction_sequences(): $wetting and
# $drying are long tibbles (event_id, sensor_id) already ordered by activation.

# turn a $wetting/$drying long tibble into per-event rank vectors --------------
event_rank_list <- function(dir_long){
  dir_long %>%
    group_by(event_id) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%          # activation order within the event
    ungroup() %>%
    { split(select(., sensor_id, rank), .$event_id) }
}

# tau + r for one watershed / one direction, all event pairs ------------------
pairwise_event_corr <- function(dir_long, shed, direction, min_shared = 3){
  rl <- event_rank_list(dir_long)
  evs <- names(rl)
  if (length(evs) < 2) return(tibble())
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  combos <- combn(evs, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  for (cc in combos){
    a <- rl[[cc[1]]]; b <- rl[[cc[2]]]
    m <- inner_join(a, b, by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_i", "_j"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    kt <- suppressWarnings(cor(m$rank_i, m$rank_j, method = "kendall"))
    pr <- suppressWarnings(cor(m$rank_i, m$rank_j, method = "pearson"))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
      shed = shed, direction = direction,
      event_i = cc[1], event_j = cc[2],
      n_shared = nrow(m), kendall_tau = kt, pearson_r = pr)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

# run for all watersheds x both directions ------------------------------------
pairwise_all <- bind_rows(
  pairwise_event_corr(ds_w3$wetting, "W3", "Wetting"),
  pairwise_event_corr(ds_w3$drying,  "W3", "Drying"),
  pairwise_event_corr(ds_fb$wetting, "FB", "Wetting"),
  pairwise_event_corr(ds_fb$drying,  "FB", "Drying"),
  pairwise_event_corr(ds_zz$wetting, "ZZ", "Wetting"),
  pairwise_event_corr(ds_zz$drying,  "ZZ", "Drying")
) %>%
  mutate(shed      = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying")))

# ── summary: distribution of each coefficient, and tau-vs-r agreement ────────
pairwise_summary <- pairwise_all %>%
  group_by(shed, direction) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs      = n(),
    mean_tau     = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_tau   = median(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_tau       = sd(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r       = mean(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r     = median(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r         = sd(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff    = mean(pearson_r - kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),   # r tends to be larger
    tau_r_corr   = cor(kendall_tau, pearson_r,
                       use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(
  pairwise_summary %>%
    mutate(across(c(mean_tau, median_tau, sd_tau, mean_r, median_r, sd_r,
                    mean_diff, tau_r_corr), ~ round(.x, 3))),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Direction", "Pairs",
                "Mean tau", "Median tau", "SD tau",
                "Mean r", "Median r", "SD r",
                "Mean (r - tau)", "tau~r rank corr"),
  caption = "Pairwise similarity of per-event activation sequences within each watershed, for wetting and drying. Each event's sequence is compared to every other event's (nodes shared by both). Reported: distribution of Kendall's tau and Pearson's r across event pairs, their mean difference, and the Spearman correlation between the two coefficients across pairs."
)
```

Compare wetting to drying
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Within each event, compare that event's WETTING sequence to its own DRYING
# sequence (nodes shared by both), using Kendall's tau and Pearson's r. Then
# summarise across all events, per watershed.
#
# Reuses event_rank_list() from the pairwise chunk. ds_*$wetting / ds_*$drying
# are the per-event long tibbles (event_id, sensor_id) from direction_sequences().

wet_dry_event_corr <- function(wet_long, dry_long, shed, min_shared = 3){
  wl <- event_rank_list(wet_long)
  dl <- event_rank_list(dry_long)
  evs <- intersect(names(wl), names(dl))          # events with both phases
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (e in evs){
    m <- inner_join(wl[[e]], dl[[e]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_wet", "_dry"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    kt <- suppressWarnings(cor(m$rank_wet, m$rank_dry, method = "kendall"))
    pr <- suppressWarnings(cor(m$rank_wet, m$rank_dry, method = "pearson"))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
      shed = shed, event_id = e, n_shared = nrow(m),
      kendall_tau = kt, pearson_r = pr)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

wet_dry_all <- bind_rows(
  wet_dry_event_corr(ds_w3$wetting, ds_w3$drying, "W3"),
  wet_dry_event_corr(ds_fb$wetting, ds_fb$drying, "FB"),
  wet_dry_event_corr(ds_zz$wetting, ds_zz$drying, "ZZ")
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")))

# ── summary across events, per watershed ─────────────────────────────────────
wet_dry_summary <- wet_dry_all %>%
  group_by(shed) %>%
  summarise(
    n_events   = n(),
    mean_tau   = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_tau = median(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_tau     = sd(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r     = mean(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r   = median(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r       = sd(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff  = mean(pearson_r - kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
    tau_r_corr = cor(kendall_tau, pearson_r,
                     use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(
  wet_dry_summary %>%
    mutate(across(c(mean_tau, median_tau, sd_tau, mean_r, median_r, sd_r,
                    mean_diff, tau_r_corr), ~ round(.x, 3))),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Events",
                "Mean tau", "Median tau", "SD tau",
                "Mean r", "Median r", "SD r",
                "Mean (r - tau)", "tau~r rank corr"),
  caption = "Within-event similarity of the wetting vs. drying sequence, summarized across events for each watershed. For every event, the wetting order and drying order are compared on their shared nodes (Kendall's tau, Pearson's r). Reported: distribution of each coefficient across events, their mean difference, and the Spearman correlation between the two coefficients across events."
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Within each event, compare its WETTING vs DRYING sequence on shared nodes,
# reporting Kendall's tau and Pearson's r WITH p-values, one row per event.
# Reuses event_rank_list() from the pairwise chunk. p-values: cor.test tests
# H0: coefficient = 0 (no association between the two orders).

wet_dry_event_tests <- function(wet_long, dry_long, shed, min_shared = 3){
  wl <- event_rank_list(wet_long)
  dl <- event_rank_list(dry_long)
  evs <- intersect(names(wl), names(dl))
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (e in evs){
    m <- inner_join(wl[[e]], dl[[e]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_wet", "_dry"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    kt <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_wet, m$rank_dry, method = "kendall"))
    pr <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_wet, m$rank_dry, method = "pearson"))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
      shed = shed, event_id = as.integer(e), n_shared = nrow(m),
      kendall_tau = unname(kt$estimate), tau_p = kt$p.value,
      pearson_r   = unname(pr$estimate), r_p   = pr$p.value)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

wet_dry_events <- bind_rows(
  wet_dry_event_tests(ds_w3$wetting, ds_w3$drying, "W3"),
  wet_dry_event_tests(ds_fb$wetting, ds_fb$drying, "FB"),
  wet_dry_event_tests(ds_zz$wetting, ds_zz$drying, "ZZ")
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ"))) %>%
  arrange(shed, event_id)

knitr::kable(
  wet_dry_events %>%
    mutate(kendall_tau = round(kendall_tau, 3),
           pearson_r   = round(pearson_r, 3),
           tau_p = format.pval(tau_p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3),
           r_p   = format.pval(r_p,   digits = 2, eps = 1e-3)),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Event", "Shared nodes",
                "Kendall tau", "tau p", "Pearson r", "r p"),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Within-event similarity of wetting vs. drying sequence, per event. Kendall's tau and Pearson's r computed on nodes shared by both phases, each with a p-value testing H0: coefficient = 0 (no association). Negative values indicate a reversed order (wets first, dries last)."
)


# Within each event, compare its WETTING vs DRYING sequence on shared nodes,
# reporting Kendall's tau and Pearson's r WITH p-values, one row per event,
# plus the number of nodes that CHANGED STATE during the event.
# Reuses event_rank_list() from the pairwise chunk.

# nodes that changed state (had both wet and dry obs) per event ---------------
changed_nodes_per_event <- function(input, event_df, ids, shed){
  input %>% filter(ID %in% ids) %>%
    inner_join(event_df %>% select(datetime, event_id, event_type), by = "datetime") %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_id), event_type != "baseflow") %>%
    group_by(event_id, ID) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), n_wet = sum(binary == 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_wet > 0, n_wet < n) %>%                 # both states seen -> changed
    group_by(event_id) %>%
    summarise(n_changed = n_distinct(ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(shed = shed, event_id = as.integer(event_id))
}

changed_counts <- bind_rows(
  changed_nodes_per_event(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, "W3"),
  changed_nodes_per_event(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, "FB"),
  changed_nodes_per_event(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, "ZZ")
)

wet_dry_event_tests <- function(wet_long, dry_long, shed, min_shared = 3){
  wl <- event_rank_list(wet_long)
  dl <- event_rank_list(dry_long)
  evs <- intersect(names(wl), names(dl))
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (e in evs){
    m <- inner_join(wl[[e]], dl[[e]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_wet", "_dry"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    kt <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_wet, m$rank_dry, method = "kendall"))
    pr <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_wet, m$rank_dry, method = "pearson"))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
      shed = shed, event_id = as.integer(e), n_shared = nrow(m),
      kendall_tau = unname(kt$estimate), tau_p = kt$p.value,
      pearson_r   = unname(pr$estimate), r_p   = pr$p.value)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

wet_dry_events <- bind_rows(
  wet_dry_event_tests(ds_w3$wetting, ds_w3$drying, "W3"),
  wet_dry_event_tests(ds_fb$wetting, ds_fb$drying, "FB"),
  wet_dry_event_tests(ds_zz$wetting, ds_zz$drying, "ZZ")
) %>%
  left_join(changed_counts, by = c("shed", "event_id")) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ"))) %>%
  arrange(shed, event_id) %>%
  select(shed, event_id, n_changed, n_shared,
         kendall_tau, tau_p, pearson_r, r_p)

knitr::kable(
  wet_dry_events %>%
    mutate(kendall_tau = round(kendall_tau, 3),
           pearson_r   = round(pearson_r, 3),
           tau_p = format.pval(tau_p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3),
           r_p   = format.pval(r_p,   digits = 2, eps = 1e-3)),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Event", "Nodes changed", "Shared nodes",
                "Kendall tau", "tau p", "Pearson r", "r p"),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Within-event similarity of wetting vs. drying sequence, per event. 'Nodes changed' = sensors that recorded both wet and dry during the event; 'Shared nodes' = sensors that activated in both the wetting and drying phases (the n used for tau and r). Each coefficient's p-value tests H0: coefficient = 0."
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 9
# Each individual event as a presence/absence tile plot, with a vertical line
# at the peak network extent separating WETTING (left) from DRYING (right).
# Reuses event_specific_order() from the fig2 chunk.
flow_tile_cols <- c("0" = "grey80", "1" = "black")   # dry / flowing; NA -> white

fig_events_wet_dry <- function(shed, input, event_df, ids,
                               consensus = NULL,
                               event_ids = NULL,
                               y_order   = c("wetting", "consensus"),
                               ncol      = NULL){
  y_order <- match.arg(y_order)

  dat_all <- input %>% filter(ID %in% ids) %>%
    inner_join(event_df %>% select(datetime, event_id, event_type), by = "datetime") %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_id), event_type != "baseflow")

  if (is.null(event_ids)) event_ids <- sort(unique(dat_all$event_id))
  dat_all <- dat_all %>% filter(event_id %in% event_ids) %>%
    group_by(event_id) %>%
    mutate(hr = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, min(datetime), units = "hours"))) %>%
    ungroup()

  # peak network-extent time (wetting/drying boundary) + event end, in hours
  bounds <- dat_all %>% group_by(event_id) %>%
    summarise(end_hr = max(hr), .groups = "drop")
  peaks <- dat_all %>%
    group_by(event_id, hr) %>%
    summarise(nw = sum(binary == 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(event_id) %>%
    slice_max(nw, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(event_id, peak_hr = hr) %>%
    left_join(bounds, by = "event_id")

  # y-axis ordering ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (y_order == "consensus"){
    if (is.null(consensus)) stop("Provide `consensus` for y_order = 'consensus'.")
    dat_plot <- dat_all %>% inner_join(consensus %>% transmute(ID, y = sequence), by = "ID")
    ylab <- "Consensus order (1 = wets first)"; yscale <- "free_x"
  } else {
    rank_tbl <- dat_all %>% group_by(event_id) %>%
      group_modify(~ event_specific_order(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>%
      rename(y = event_rank)
    dat_plot <- dat_all %>% inner_join(rank_tbl, by = c("event_id", "ID"))
    ylab <- "Event wetting order (1 = wets first)"; yscale <- "free"
  }

  ggplot(dat_plot, aes(hr, y, fill = factor(binary))) +
    # shade the drying side lightly, then tiles, then the boundary line
    geom_rect(data = peaks, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(xmin = peak_hr, xmax = end_hr, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
              fill = "grey95") +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_vline(data = peaks, aes(xintercept = peak_hr),
               linetype = 2, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = flow_tile_cols, breaks = c("0", "1"),
                      labels = c("Dry", "Flowing"), name = "",
                      drop = FALSE, na.value = "white") +
    facet_wrap(~ event_id, scales = yscale, ncol = ncol) +
    labs(x = "Hours since event start", y = ylab,
         title = paste0(shed, ": wetting (left of line) vs. drying (right, shaded)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "top",
          axis.text = element_text(size = 8))
}

# W3, all events, ordered by each event's own wetting sequence ----------------
fig_wet_dry_w3 <- fig_events_wet_dry(
  shed = "W3", input = input_w3, event_df = w3_events_all, ids = W3_IDs,
  y_order = "wetting")
fig_wet_dry_w3
ggsave("figure_events_wet_dry_w3.pdf", fig_wet_dry_w3, width = 11, height = 9)


# FB, all events, ordered by each event's own wetting sequence ----------------
fig_wet_dry_fb <- fig_events_wet_dry(
  shed = "FB", input = input_fb, event_df = FBall_events, ids = FB_IDs,
  y_order = "wetting")
fig_wet_dry_fb
ggsave("figure_events_wet_dry_fb.pdf", fig_wet_dry_fb, width = 11, height = 9)

# ZZ, all events, ordered by each event's own wetting sequence ----------------

  shed = "ZZ", input = input_zz, event_df = ZZall_events, ids = ZZ_IDs,
  y_order = "wetting")
fig_wet_dry_zz
ggsave("figure_events_wet_dry_zz.pdf", fig_wet_dry_zz, width = 11, height = 9)
```

Filter events to only ones where 5 nodes wetted and dried
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Return the event IDs where at least `min_n` sensors BOTH wetted and dried
# during the event. "Wetted" = went dry->flowing at some point within the event;
# "dried" = went flowing->dry. A sensor counts toward the threshold only if it
# did both, so these are the nodes with a full activation/deactivation cycle.
events_with_transitions <- function(input, event_df, ids, min_n = 5){
  input %>%
    filter(ID %in% ids) %>%
    inner_join(event_df %>% select(datetime, event_id, event_type), by = "datetime") %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_id), event_type != "baseflow") %>%
    arrange(event_id, ID, datetime) %>%
    group_by(event_id, ID) %>%
    summarise(
      wetted = any(binary == 1 & lag(binary) == 0),   # a dry->wet transition
      dried  = any(binary == 0 & lag(binary) == 1),   # a wet->dry transition
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(wetted, dried) %>%                          # sensor did both
    count(event_id, name = "n_cycled") %>%
    filter(n_cycled >= min_n) %>%
    pull(event_id) %>%
    sort()
}
unique(w3_events_all$event_id)
unique(FBall_events$event_id)
unique(ZZall_events$event_id)

w3_keep <- events_with_transitions(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, min_n = 5)
fb_keep <- events_with_transitions(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, min_n = 5)
zz_keep <- events_with_transitions(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, min_n = 5)

fig_events_wet_dry("W3", input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs,
                   y_order = "wetting", event_ids = w3_keep)
fig_events_wet_dry("FB", input_fb, FBall_events, FB_IDs,
                   y_order = "wetting", event_ids = fb_keep)
fig_events_wet_dry("ZZ", input_zz, ZZall_events, ZZ_IDs,
                   y_order = "wetting", event_ids = zz_keep)
```


```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# ---- Curation: trustworthy directions per event (from before) ---------------
dir_spec <- list(
  W3 = list(remove = c(13, 18), wetting_only = c(8, 10),            drying_only = integer(0)),
  FB = list(remove = c(1),      wetting_only = c(3, 5, 9),          drying_only = c(7, 10, 12)),
  ZZ = list(remove = c(10),     wetting_only = c(3, 4, 11, 12, 13), drying_only = integer(0))
)
universe <- list(W3 = 1:18, FB = 1:19, ZZ = 1:18)   # total events per watershed

both_dir_events <- function(spec, u)
  sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$wetting_only, spec$drying_only)))

# ---- Transition filter: >= 5 sensors that go dry->wet AND wet->dry ----------
events_with_transitions <- function(input, event_df, ids, min_n = 5){
  input %>%
    filter(ID %in% ids) %>%
    inner_join(event_df %>% select(datetime, event_id, event_type), by = "datetime") %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_id), event_type != "baseflow") %>%
    arrange(event_id, ID, datetime) %>%
    group_by(event_id, ID) %>%
    summarise(wetted = any(binary == 1 & lag(binary) == 0),
              dried  = any(binary == 0 & lag(binary) == 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(wetted, dried) %>%
    count(event_id, name = "n_cycled") %>%
    filter(n_cycled >= min_n) %>%
    pull(event_id) %>% sort()
}

# ---- Combine curation + transition filter -----------------------------------
keep_curated <- Map(both_dir_events, dir_spec, universe)
keep_trans <- list(
  W3 = events_with_transitions(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, 5),
  FB = events_with_transitions(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, 5),
  ZZ = events_with_transitions(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, 5)
)
keep <- Map(intersect, keep_curated, keep_trans)
for (s in names(keep))
  message(s, ": ", length(keep[[s]]), " events after curation + >=5 cycled -> ",
          paste(keep[[s]], collapse = ", "))

# ---- per-event wetting-vs-drying tests --------------------------------------
event_rank_list <- function(dir_long){
  dir_long %>% group_by(event_id) %>% mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    { split(select(., sensor_id, rank), .$event_id) }
}
wet_dry_event_tests <- function(wet_long, dry_long, shed, keep_events, min_shared = 3){
  wl <- event_rank_list(wet_long); dl <- event_rank_list(dry_long)
  evs <- intersect(intersect(names(wl), names(dl)), as.character(keep_events))
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (e in evs){
    m <- inner_join(wl[[e]], dl[[e]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_wet", "_dry"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    kt <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_wet, m$rank_dry, method = "kendall"))
    pr <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_wet, m$rank_dry, method = "pearson"))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
      shed = shed, event_id = as.integer(e), n_shared = nrow(m),
      kendall_tau = unname(kt$estimate), tau_p = kt$p.value,
      pearson_r   = unname(pr$estimate), r_p   = pr$p.value)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

wet_dry_events <- bind_rows(
  wet_dry_event_tests(ds_w3$wetting, ds_w3$drying, "W3", keep$W3),
  wet_dry_event_tests(ds_fb$wetting, ds_fb$drying, "FB", keep$FB),
  wet_dry_event_tests(ds_zz$wetting, ds_zz$drying, "ZZ", keep$ZZ)
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ"))) %>%
  arrange(shed, event_id)

# ---- Table 1: per event -----------------------------------------------------
knitr::kable(
  wet_dry_events %>%
    mutate(kendall_tau = round(kendall_tau, 3), pearson_r = round(pearson_r, 3),
           tau_p = format.pval(tau_p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3),
           r_p   = format.pval(r_p,   digits = 2, eps = 1e-3)),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Event", "Shared nodes",
                "Kendall tau", "tau p", "Pearson r", "r p"),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Per-event wetting-vs-drying similarity. Events curated for valid directions and further restricted to those with >= 5 sensors that both wetted (dry->wet) and dried (wet->dry) during the event. Negative tau = reversed order.")

# ---- Table 2: average across kept events ------------------------------------
wet_dry_summary <- wet_dry_events %>%
  group_by(shed) %>%
  summarise(n_events   = n(),
            mean_tau   = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_tau = median(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_tau     = sd(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_r     = mean(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_r   = median(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_r       = sd(pearson_r, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(
  wet_dry_summary %>%
    mutate(across(c(mean_tau, median_tau, sd_tau, mean_r, median_r, sd_r), ~ round(.x, 3))),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Events", "Mean tau", "Median tau", "SD tau",
                "Mean r", "Median r", "SD r"),
  caption = "Average wetting-vs-drying similarity across curated events with >= 5 fully-cycling sensors.")
```

Wetting compared to wetting
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Reuses dir_spec, universe, events_with_transitions(), event_rank_list() from
# the previous chunks. Wetting-vs-wetting comparison: an event is eligible if its
# WETTING order is valid -> both-direction events + wetting_only events, minus
# removed events, then gated by >= 5 fully-cycling sensors.

wetting_eligible <- function(spec, u)
  sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$drying_only)))   # keep both + wetting_only

keep_wet_curated <- Map(wetting_eligible, dir_spec, universe)
keep_trans <- list(
  W3 = events_with_transitions(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, 5),
  FB = events_with_transitions(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, 5),
  ZZ = events_with_transitions(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, 5)
)
keep_wet <- Map(intersect, keep_wet_curated, keep_trans)
for (s in names(keep_wet))
  message(s, ": ", length(keep_wet[[s]]), " wetting events -> ",
          paste(keep_wet[[s]], collapse = ", "))

# ---- all-pairs wetting-vs-wetting within a watershed ------------------------
pairwise_wetting <- function(wet_long, shed, keep_events, min_shared = 3){
  rl <- event_rank_list(wet_long)
  evs <- intersect(names(rl), as.character(keep_events))
  if (length(evs) < 2) return(tibble())
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (cc in combn(evs, 2, simplify = FALSE)){
    m <- inner_join(rl[[cc[1]]], rl[[cc[2]]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_i", "_j"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    kt <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_i, m$rank_j, method = "kendall"))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
      shed = shed, event_i = as.integer(cc[1]), event_j = as.integer(cc[2]),
      n_shared = nrow(m), kendall_tau = unname(kt$estimate), tau_p = kt$p.value)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

wetting_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pairwise_wetting(ds_w3$wetting, "W3", keep_wet$W3),
  pairwise_wetting(ds_fb$wetting, "FB", keep_wet$FB),
  pairwise_wetting(ds_zz$wetting, "ZZ", keep_wet$ZZ)
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ"))) %>%
  arrange(shed, event_i, event_j)

# ---- Table 1: every wetting-event pair --------------------------------------
knitr::kable(
  wetting_pairs %>%
    mutate(kendall_tau = round(kendall_tau, 3),
           tau_p = format.pval(tau_p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3)),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Event i", "Event j", "Shared nodes",
                "Kendall tau", "tau p"),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Pairwise similarity of every wetting sequence to every other wetting sequence within a watershed. Events eligible if their wetting order is valid (both-direction + wetting-only, removed excluded) and >= 5 sensors fully cycled. Kendall tau on shared nodes; p tests H0: tau = 0.")

# ---- Table 2: per-watershed summary across pairs ----------------------------
wetting_pairs_summary <- wetting_pairs %>%
  group_by(shed) %>%
  summarise(n_events   = length(unique(c(event_i, event_j))),
            n_pairs    = n(),
            mean_tau   = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_tau = median(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_tau     = sd(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            frac_sig   = mean(tau_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(
  wetting_pairs_summary %>%
    mutate(across(c(mean_tau, median_tau, sd_tau, frac_sig), ~ round(.x, 3))),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Events", "Pairs", "Mean tau", "Median tau",
                "SD tau", "Frac. p<0.05"),
  caption = "Consistency of the wetting sequence through time: distribution of pairwise Kendall tau across all wetting-event pairs per watershed.")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Combines three analyses into one interpretable summary per watershed:
#   (1) Wetting consistency  = pairwise tau among wetting sequences (across events)
#   (2) Drying consistency   = pairwise tau among drying sequences (across events)
#   (3) Wetting vs drying    = within-event tau between an event's wetting & drying
# Consistency tau > 0 and high  -> same order event to event.
# Wet-vs-dry tau < 0            -> drying REVERSES wetting (fill-and-spill).

summ <- function(df, tau = kendall_tau){
  tau <- rlang::enquo(tau)
  df %>% group_by(shed) %>%
    summarise(n_pairs  = n(),
              mean_tau = mean(!!tau, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_tau   = sd(!!tau, na.rm = TRUE),
              frac_sig = mean(tau_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")
}

consistency <- bind_rows(
  summ(wetting_pairs) %>% mutate(comparison = "Wetting consistency (across events)"),
  summ(drying_pairs)  %>% mutate(comparison = "Drying consistency (across events)"),
  wet_dry_events %>% group_by(shed) %>%          # within-event wetting vs drying
    summarise(n_pairs  = n(),
              mean_tau = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_tau   = sd(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
              frac_sig = mean(tau_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(comparison = "Wetting vs drying (within event)")
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c(
           "Wetting consistency (across events)",
           "Drying consistency (across events)",
           "Wetting vs drying (within event)"))) %>%
  # plain-language verdict per row
  mutate(interpretation = case_when(
    comparison != "Wetting vs drying (within event)" & mean_tau >= 0.5 ~ "Highly consistent",
    comparison != "Wetting vs drying (within event)" & mean_tau >= 0.3 ~ "Moderately consistent",
    comparison != "Wetting vs drying (within event)"                   ~ "Weakly consistent",
    mean_tau <= -0.3 ~ "Reversed (dries opposite to wetting)",
    mean_tau <   0.3 & mean_tau > -0.3 ~ "Largely independent",
    TRUE ~ "Same order both directions")) %>%
  arrange(shed, comparison) %>%
  select(shed, comparison, n_pairs, mean_tau, sd_tau, frac_sig, interpretation)

knitr::kable(
  consistency %>% mutate(across(c(mean_tau, sd_tau, frac_sig), ~ round(.x, 3))),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Comparison", "n", "Mean tau", "SD tau",
                "Frac. p<0.05", "Interpretation"),
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l"),
  caption = "Combined sequence analysis. Rows 1-2: internal consistency of the wetting and drying sequences across events (high positive tau = same order each event). Row 3: within-event comparison of wetting vs drying order (negative tau = drying reverses wetting). n = event pairs (rows 1-2) or events (row 3).")
```

Add wilcoxon test
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Combines three analyses per watershed:
#   (1) Wetting consistency = pairwise tau among wetting sequences across events
#   (2) Drying consistency  = pairwise tau among drying sequences across events
#   (3) Wetting vs drying   = within-event tau between an event's wetting & drying,
#       tested with a one-sample Wilcoxon signed-rank test (H0: median tau = 0).

summ_consistency <- function(df, label){
  df %>% group_by(shed) %>%
    summarise(n        = n(),
              mean_tau = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_tau   = sd(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
              frac_sig = mean(tau_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
              wilcox_p = NA_real_,
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(comparison = label)
}

# within-event wetting-vs-drying: Wilcoxon signed-rank on the per-event taus ----
wet_dry_wilcox <- wet_dry_events %>%
  group_by(shed) %>%
  summarise(n        = n(),
            mean_tau = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_tau   = sd(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            frac_sig = NA_real_,
            wilcox_p = tryCatch(
              wilcox.test(kendall_tau, mu = 0)$p.value,
              error = function(e) NA_real_),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Wetting vs drying (within event)")

consistency <- bind_rows(
  summ_consistency(wetting_pairs, "Wetting consistency (across events)"),
  summ_consistency(drying_pairs,  "Drying consistency (across events)"),
  wet_dry_wilcox
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c(
           "Wetting consistency (across events)",
           "Drying consistency (across events)",
           "Wetting vs drying (within event)"))) %>%
  mutate(interpretation = case_when(
    comparison != "Wetting vs drying (within event)" & mean_tau >= 0.5 ~ "Highly consistent",
    comparison != "Wetting vs drying (within event)" & mean_tau >= 0.3 ~ "Moderately consistent",
    comparison != "Wetting vs drying (within event)"                   ~ "Weakly consistent",
    mean_tau <= -0.3 & wilcox_p < 0.05 ~ "Significantly reversed",
    mean_tau <    0  & wilcox_p < 0.05 ~ "Reversed (weak but sig.)",
    wilcox_p >= 0.05 | is.na(wilcox_p) ~ "No sig. difference",
    TRUE ~ "Same order both directions")) %>%
  arrange(shed, comparison) %>%
  select(shed, comparison, n, mean_tau, sd_tau, frac_sig, wilcox_p, interpretation)

knitr::kable(
  consistency %>%
    mutate(across(c(mean_tau, sd_tau, frac_sig), ~ round(.x, 3)),
           wilcox_p = ifelse(is.na(wilcox_p), "—",
                             format.pval(wilcox_p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3))),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Comparison", "n", "Mean tau", "SD tau",
                "Frac. p<0.05", "Wilcoxon p", "Interpretation"),
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l"),
  caption = "Combined sequence analysis. Rows 1-2: internal consistency of wetting and drying sequences across events (Frac. p<0.05 = share of event pairs with significant positive tau). Row 3: within-event wetting-vs-drying order, tested with a one-sample Wilcoxon signed-rank test (H0: median tau = 0); negative mean tau = drying reverses wetting. n = event pairs (rows 1-2) or events (row 3).")
```

```{r}
# Two panels (wetting | drying). Each point = one event pair within a watershed:
# y = Kendall's tau between the two events' sequences (from wetting_pairs /
# drying_pairs), x = |difference in antecedent wetness| between the two events.
# Antecedent wetness = 15-day rolling precipitation sum up to each event's start.

# ---- 1. antecedent wetness index (AWI) per event, per watershed -------------
# Needs a precip series per watershed with columns: datetime, hourly_precip.
# W3 uses precip1; substitute your FB/ZZ precip series if you have them.
antecedent_wetness <- function(precip, event_df, window_days = 15){
  ev_start <- event_df %>% filter(!is.na(event_id)) %>%
    group_by(event_id) %>% summarise(start = min(datetime), .groups = "drop")
  p <- precip %>% arrange(datetime)
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(ev_start)), function(i){
    t0 <- ev_start$start[i]
    awi <- p %>% filter(datetime <= t0,
                        datetime >  t0 - lubridate::days(window_days)) %>%
      summarise(awi = sum(hourly_precip, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(awi)
    tibble(event_id = ev_start$event_id[i], awi = awi)
  })
}

awi <- bind_rows(
  antecedent_wetness(precip1,     w3_events_all) %>% mutate(shed = "W3"),
  antecedent_wetness(precip1,   FBall_events)  %>% mutate(shed = "FB"),
  antecedent_wetness(precip1,   ZZall_events)  %>% mutate(shed = "ZZ")
)

# ---- 2. attach |AWI difference| to each event pair --------------------------
add_awi_diff <- function(pairs, direction){
  pairs %>%
    left_join(awi %>% rename(awi_i = awi), by = c("shed", "event_i" = "event_id")) %>%
    left_join(awi %>% rename(awi_j = awi), by = c("shed", "event_j" = "event_id")) %>%
    mutate(awi_diff = abs(awi_i - awi_j), direction = direction) %>%
    filter(!is.na(awi_diff))
}

  add_awi_diff(drying_pairs,  "Drying")
) %>%
  mutate(shed      = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying")))
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
# Antecedent wetness at 7/15/30-day windows x 2 directions, all sheds on precip1.
# Point = event pair; y = Kendall's tau, x = |diff in antecedent precip sum|.
# A per-watershed trend line is drawn ONLY if its slope is significant by a
# Mantel-style permutation test (event-label permutation), which respects the
# non-independence of pairwise data.

antecedent_wetness <- function(precip, event_df, window_days){
  ev_start <- event_df %>% filter(!is.na(event_id)) %>%
    group_by(event_id) %>% summarise(start = min(datetime), .groups = "drop")
  p <- precip %>% arrange(datetime)
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(ev_start)), function(i){
    t0 <- ev_start$start[i]
    a <- p %>% filter(datetime <= t0, datetime > t0 - lubridate::days(window_days)) %>%
      summarise(a = sum(hourly_precip, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(a)
    tibble(event_id = ev_start$event_id[i], awi = a)
  })
}

windows <- c(7, 15, 30)
awi_all <- purrr::map_dfr(windows, function(w){
  bind_rows(
    antecedent_wetness(precip1, w3_events_all, w) %>% mutate(shed = "W3"),
    antecedent_wetness(precip1, FBall_events,  w) %>% mutate(shed = "FB"),
    antecedent_wetness(precip1, ZZall_events,  w) %>% mutate(shed = "ZZ")
  ) %>% mutate(window = w)
})

add_awi_diff <- function(pairs, direction, awi_w){
  pairs %>%
    left_join(awi_w %>% rename(a_i = awi), by = c("shed", "event_i" = "event_id")) %>%
    left_join(awi_w %>% rename(a_j = awi), by = c("shed", "event_j" = "event_id")) %>%
    mutate(awi_diff = abs(a_i - a_j), direction = direction) %>%
    filter(!is.na(awi_diff))
}

pair_awi <- purrr::map_dfr(windows, function(w){
  aw <- awi_all %>% filter(window == w)
  bind_rows(add_awi_diff(wetting_pairs, "Wetting", aw),
            add_awi_diff(drying_pairs,  "Drying",  aw)) %>%
    mutate(window = w)
}) %>%
  mutate(shed      = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying")),
         window_lab = factor(paste0(window, "-day window"),
                             levels = paste0(windows, "-day window")))

# ---- Mantel-style significance of the tau ~ predictor slope -----------------
# Pass the predictor's two per-event columns by name (col_i, col_j) so we never
# have to guess them from xvar.
mantel_slope_p <- function(df, xvar, col_i, col_j, n_perm = 999){
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[xvar]]), !is.na(kendall_tau))
  evs <- unique(c(df$event_i, df$event_j))
  if (length(evs) < 4 || nrow(df) < 4) return(NA_real_)

  obs <- coef(lm(reformulate(xvar, "kendall_tau"), df))[2]

  # one predictor value per event, gathered from the i and j columns
  ev_val <- bind_rows(
    df %>% transmute(event = event_i, v = .data[[col_i]]),
    df %>% transmute(event = event_j, v = .data[[col_j]])
  ) %>% distinct(event, v) %>% { setNames(.$v, as.character(.$event)) }

  perm_stat <- replicate(n_perm, {
    permap <- setNames(sample(evs), as.character(evs))   # shuffle event identities
    ip <- permap[as.character(df$event_i)]
    jp <- permap[as.character(df$event_j)]
    xp <- abs(ev_val[as.character(ip)] - ev_val[as.character(jp)])
    coef(lm(df$kendall_tau ~ xp))[2]
  })
  (1 + sum(abs(perm_stat) >= abs(obs))) / (1 + n_perm)
}

sig_awi <- pair_awi %>%
  group_by(shed, direction, window_lab) %>%
  group_modify(~ tibble(p = mantel_slope_p(.x, "awi_diff", "a_i", "a_j"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(!is.na(p), p < 0.05)

pair_awi_sig <- pair_awi %>% inner_join(sig_awi, by = c("shed", "direction", "window_lab"))

shed_cols <- c("W3" = "#FFB000", "FB" = "#397367", "ZZ" = "#7E6B8F")

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(data = pair_awi_sig, method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              linewidth = 0.7, aes(group = shed)) +      # only significant sheds
  facet_grid(direction ~ window_lab) +
  scale_color_manual(values = shed_cols, name = "Watershed") +
  labs(x = "Difference in antecedent precipitation sum between events (mm)",
       y = "Kendall's tau between event sequences",
       title = "Sequence similarity vs. antecedent wetness (trend shown only where significant, p < 0.05)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

ggsave("figure_tau_antecedent_windows.pdf", fig_windows, width = 12, height = 8)
```

One more test, Tau comparing test sequences to actual wetting and drying during events
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6
# For each event, compare its WETTING and DRYING sequence to the two MODEL
# sequences (Flow Persistence, TWI) via Kendall's tau on shared nodes.
# Drying ranks are REVERSED (1 = dries last) so that, like wetting and like the
# model sequences, rank 1 = most persistent -> positive tau = model agrees.

wetting_eligible <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$drying_only)))
drying_eligible  <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$wetting_only)))
keep_trans <- list(
  W3 = events_with_transitions(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, 5),
  FB = events_with_transitions(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, 5),
  ZZ = events_with_transitions(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, 5))
keep_wet <- Map(intersect, Map(wetting_eligible, dir_spec, universe), keep_trans)
keep_dry <- Map(intersect, Map(drying_eligible,  dir_spec, universe), keep_trans)

tau_event_model <- function(ev_ranks, model_seq, min_shared = 3){
  m <- ev_ranks %>%
    inner_join(model_seq %>% transmute(sensor_id = ID, mrank = sequence),
               by = "sensor_id")
  if (nrow(m) < min_shared) return(tibble(tau = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = nrow(m)))
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank, m$mrank, method = "kendall"))
  tibble(tau = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = nrow(m))
}

compare_dir <- function(dir_long, keep_events, pk_seq, twi_seq, shed, direction){
  rl <- event_rank_list(dir_long)
  evs <- intersect(names(rl), as.character(keep_events))
  purrr::map_dfr(evs, function(e){
    er <- rl[[e]]
    # reverse drying ranks: 1 = dries last (most persistent), matching model order
    if (direction == "Drying") er <- er %>% mutate(rank = max(rank) - rank + 1)
    bind_rows(
      tau_event_model(er, pk_seq)  %>% mutate(model = "Flow Persistence"),
      tau_event_model(er, twi_seq) %>% mutate(model = "TWI")
    ) %>% mutate(shed = shed, direction = direction, event_id = as.integer(e))
  })
}

event_model_tau <- bind_rows(
  compare_dir(ds_w3$wetting, keep_wet$W3, W3_pk_seq, w3_twi_sequence, "W3", "Wetting"),
  compare_dir(ds_w3$drying,  keep_dry$W3, W3_pk_seq, w3_twi_sequence, "W3", "Drying"),
  compare_dir(ds_fb$wetting, keep_wet$FB, FB_pk_seq, fb_twi_sequence, "FB", "Wetting"),
  compare_dir(ds_fb$drying,  keep_dry$FB, FB_pk_seq, fb_twi_sequence, "FB", "Drying"),
  compare_dir(ds_zz$wetting, keep_wet$ZZ, ZZ_pk_seq, zz_twi_sequence, "ZZ", "Wetting"),
  compare_dir(ds_zz$drying,  keep_dry$ZZ, ZZ_pk_seq, zz_twi_sequence, "ZZ", "Drying")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tau)) %>%
  mutate(shed      = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying")),
         model     = factor(model, levels = c("Flow Persistence", "TWI")))

model_cols <- c("Flow Persistence" = "#1b7837", "TWI" = "#762a83")

fig_event_model <- ggplot(event_model_tau,
                          aes(x = direction, y = tau, fill = model, color = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, alpha = 0.25, outlier.shape = NA,
               position = position_dodge(0.65)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = 0.65)) +
  facet_wrap(~ shed) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_cols, name = "Model sequence") +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_cols, name = "Model sequence") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Kendall's tau (event sequence vs. model)",
       title = "How well do Flow Persistence and TWI predict each event's wetting and drying order?",
       subtitle = "Drying ranks reversed (1 = dries last) so positive tau = model captures the order in both directions") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

fig_event_model
ggsave("figure_event_vs_model_tau.pdf", fig_event_model, width = 11, height = 6)

event_model_summary <- event_model_tau %>%
  group_by(shed, direction, model) %>%
  summarise(n_events = n(),
            mean_tau = mean(tau), median_tau = median(tau), sd_tau = sd(tau),
            frac_sig = mean(p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(
  event_model_summary %>%
    mutate(across(c(mean_tau, median_tau, sd_tau, frac_sig), ~ round(.x, 3))),
  caption = "Per-event agreement (Kendall's tau) of each event's wetting and (reversed) drying order with the Flow Persistence and TWI model sequences.")
```
