```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
# For each event, compare its WETTING and (reversed) DRYING sequence to THREE
# model sequences: Flow Persistence, TWI, and BFS. Kendall's tau on shared nodes.
# Drying ranks reversed (1 = dries last) so positive tau = model agrees in both
# directions. best_bfs_w3/fb/zz are dataframes with columns ID, sequence.

wetting_eligible <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$drying_only)))
drying_eligible  <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$wetting_only)))
keep_trans <- list(
  W3 = events_with_transitions(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, 5),
  FB = events_with_transitions(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, 5),
  ZZ = events_with_transitions(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, 5))
keep_wet <- Map(intersect, Map(wetting_eligible, dir_spec, universe), keep_trans)
keep_dry <- Map(intersect, Map(drying_eligible,  dir_spec, universe), keep_trans)

tau_event_model <- function(ev_ranks, model_seq, min_shared = 3){
  m <- ev_ranks %>%
    inner_join(model_seq %>% transmute(sensor_id = ID, mrank = sequence),
               by = "sensor_id")
  if (nrow(m) < min_shared) return(tibble(tau = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = nrow(m)))
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank, m$mrank, method = "kendall"))
  tibble(tau = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = nrow(m))
}

# now takes a named list of model sequences ----------------------------------
compare_dir <- function(dir_long, keep_events, models, shed, direction){
  rl <- event_rank_list(dir_long)
  evs <- intersect(names(rl), as.character(keep_events))
  purrr::map_dfr(evs, function(e){
    er <- rl[[e]]
    if (direction == "Drying") er <- er %>% mutate(rank = max(rank) - rank + 1)
    purrr::imap_dfr(models, function(mseq, mname)
      tau_event_model(er, mseq) %>% mutate(model = mname)) %>%
      mutate(shed = shed, direction = direction, event_id = as.integer(e))
  })
}

models_w3 <- list("Flow Persistence" = W3_pk_seq, "TWI" = w3_twi_sequence, "BFS" = best_bfs_w3)
models_fb <- list("Flow Persistence" = FB_pk_seq, "TWI" = fb_twi_sequence, "BFS" = best_bfs_fb)
models_zz <- list("Flow Persistence" = ZZ_pk_seq, "TWI" = zz_twi_sequence, "BFS" = best_bfs_zz)

event_model_tau <- bind_rows(
  compare_dir(ds_w3$wetting, keep_wet$W3, models_w3, "W3", "Wetting"),
  compare_dir(ds_w3$drying,  keep_dry$W3, models_w3, "W3", "Drying"),
  compare_dir(ds_fb$wetting, keep_wet$FB, models_fb, "FB", "Wetting"),
  compare_dir(ds_fb$drying,  keep_dry$FB, models_fb, "FB", "Drying"),
  compare_dir(ds_zz$wetting, keep_wet$ZZ, models_zz, "ZZ", "Wetting"),
  compare_dir(ds_zz$drying,  keep_dry$ZZ, models_zz, "ZZ", "Drying")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tau)) %>%
  mutate(shed      = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying")),
         model     = factor(model, levels = c("Flow Persistence", "TWI", "BFS")))

model_cols <- c("Flow Persistence" = "#1b7837", "TWI" = "#762a83", "BFS" = "#bb4430")

fig_event_model <- ggplot(event_model_tau,
                          aes(x = direction, y = tau, fill = model, color = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.25, outlier.shape = NA,

  scale_fill_manual(values = model_cols, name = "Model sequence") +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_cols, name = "Model sequence") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Kendall's tau (event sequence vs. model)",
       title = "How well do Flow Persistence, TWI, and BFS predict each event's wetting and drying order?",
       subtitle = "Drying ranks reversed (1 = dries last) so positive tau = model captures the order in both directions") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

fig_event_model
ggsave("figure_event_vs_model_tau.pdf", fig_event_model, width = 12, height = 6)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6
# Each individual BFS sequence (one per starting node, from *_allout) tested
# against each kept observed event sequence (wetting and reversed drying) via
# Kendall's tau on shared nodes. Every point = one (BFS start x observed event)
# comparison; boxes pool all such comparisons per watershed x direction.
# Drying ranks reversed (1 = dries last) so positive tau = BFS captures the order.

wetting_eligible <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$drying_only)))
drying_eligible  <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$wetting_only)))
keep_trans <- list(
  W3 = events_with_transitions(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, 5),
  FB = events_with_transitions(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, 5),
  ZZ = events_with_transitions(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, 5))
keep_wet <- Map(intersect, Map(wetting_eligible, dir_spec, universe), keep_trans)
keep_dry <- Map(intersect, Map(drying_eligible,  dir_spec, universe), keep_trans)

# rank each BFS start sequence (same construction as event_rank_list) ---------
bfs_rank_list <- function(allout){
  allout %>% group_by(event_id) %>% mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    { split(select(., sensor_id, rank), .$event_id) }
}

# cross every BFS start against every kept observed event --------------------
compare_bfs_dir <- function(dir_long, keep_events, bfs_allout, shed, direction,
                            min_shared = 3){
  obs <- event_rank_list(dir_long)
  obs_evs <- intersect(names(obs), as.character(keep_events))
  bfs <- bfs_rank_list(bfs_allout)
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (be in names(bfs)){
    bseq <- bfs[[be]] %>% dplyr::rename(mrank = rank)
    for (oe in obs_evs){
      er <- obs[[oe]]
      if (direction == "Drying") er <- er %>% mutate(rank = max(rank) - rank + 1)
      m <- er %>% inner_join(bseq, by = "sensor_id")
      if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
      ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank, m$mrank, method = "kendall"))
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
        shed = shed, direction = direction,
        bfs_start = as.integer(be), obs_event = as.integer(oe),
        tau = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = nrow(m))
    }
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

  compare_bfs_dir(ds_w3$drying,  keep_dry$W3, w3_allout, "W3", "Drying"),
  compare_bfs_dir(ds_fb$wetting, keep_wet$FB, fb_allout, "FB", "Wetting"),
  compare_bfs_dir(ds_fb$drying,  keep_dry$FB, fb_allout, "FB", "Drying"),
  compare_bfs_dir(ds_zz$wetting, keep_wet$ZZ, zz_allout, "ZZ", "Wetting"),
  compare_bfs_dir(ds_zz$drying,  keep_dry$ZZ, zz_allout, "ZZ", "Drying")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tau)) %>%
  mutate(shed      = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying")))

dir_cols <- c("Wetting" = "#93C2F1", "Drying" = "#FFA400")
```

Grid of taus of observed sequences; FINAL FIGURE
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
# Heatmap of pairwise Kendall's tau between observed event sequences, per
# watershed x direction. Diagonal left blank. Events restricted to the curated
# subset (both-direction + direction-specific, >= 5 cycling sensors).

reorder_events <- FALSE

# define set of events to use for each watershed
dir_spec <- list(
  W3 = list(remove = c(13, 18), wetting_only = c(8, 10),            drying_only = integer(0)),
  FB = list(remove = c(1),      wetting_only = c(3, 5, 9),          drying_only = c(7, 10, 12)),
  ZZ = list(remove = c(),     wetting_only = c(4, 11, 12, 13), drying_only = c(1))
)
universe <- list(W3 = 1:18, FB = 1:19, ZZ = 1:18)
# curated event sets (from earlier) ------------------------------------------
wetting_eligible <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$drying_only)))
drying_eligible  <- function(spec, u) sort(setdiff(u, c(spec$remove, spec$wetting_only)))
keep_trans <- list(
  W3 = events_with_transitions(input_w3, w3_events_all, W3_IDs, 3),
  FB = events_with_transitions(input_fb, FBall_events,  FB_IDs, 3),
  ZZ = events_with_transitions(input_zz, ZZall_events,  ZZ_IDs, 3))
keep_wet <- Map(intersect, Map(wetting_eligible, dir_spec, universe), keep_trans)
keep_dry <- Map(intersect, Map(drying_eligible,  dir_spec, universe), keep_trans)

# calculate drying and wetting pairs
# ---- wetting pairs

# ---- all-pairs wetting-vs-wetting within a watershed ------------------------
pairwise_wetting <- function(wet_long, shed, keep_events, min_shared = 3){
  rl <- event_rank_list(wet_long)
  evs <- intersect(names(rl), as.character(keep_events))
  if (length(evs) < 2) return(tibble())
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (cc in combn(evs, 2, simplify = FALSE)){
    m <- inner_join(rl[[cc[1]]], rl[[cc[2]]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_i", "_j"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    kt <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_i, m$rank_j, method = "kendall"))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
      shed = shed, event_i = as.integer(cc[1]), event_j = as.integer(cc[2]),
      n_shared = nrow(m), kendall_tau = unname(kt$estimate), tau_p = kt$p.value)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

wetting_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pairwise_wetting(ds_w3$wetting, "W3", keep_wet$W3),
  pairwise_wetting(ds_fb$wetting, "FB", keep_wet$FB),
  pairwise_wetting(ds_zz$wetting, "ZZ", keep_wet$ZZ)
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ"))) %>%
  arrange(shed, event_i, event_j)

# ---- all-pairs drying-vs-drying within a watershed --------------------------
pairwise_drying <- function(dry_long, shed, keep_events, min_shared = 3){
  rl <- event_rank_list(dry_long)
  evs <- intersect(names(rl), as.character(keep_events))
  if (length(evs) < 2) return(tibble())
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (cc in combn(evs, 2, simplify = FALSE)){
    m <- inner_join(rl[[cc[1]]], rl[[cc[2]]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_i", "_j"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    kt <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_i, m$rank_j, method = "kendall"))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
      shed = shed, event_i = as.integer(cc[1]), event_j = as.integer(cc[2]),
      n_shared = nrow(m), kendall_tau = unname(kt$estimate), tau_p = kt$p.value)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

drying_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pairwise_drying(ds_w3$drying, "W3", keep_dry$W3),
  pairwise_drying(ds_fb$drying, "FB", keep_dry$FB),
  pairwise_drying(ds_zz$drying, "ZZ", keep_dry$ZZ)
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ"))) %>%
  arrange(shed, event_i, event_j)

# long, symmetric tau (NO diagonal), filtered to the eligible events ----------
tau_matrix_long <- function(pairs, direction, keep_list){
  purrr::imap_dfr(keep_list, function(evs, shed_sel){
    p <- pairs %>% filter(shed == shed_sel, event_i %in% evs, event_j %in% evs)
    if (nrow(p) == 0) return(tibble())
    bind_rows(
      p %>% transmute(shed = shed_sel, a = event_i, b = event_j, kendall_tau),
      p %>% transmute(shed = shed_sel, a = event_j, b = event_i, kendall_tau)
    )
  }) %>% mutate(direction = direction)
}

tau_long <- bind_rows(
  tau_matrix_long(wetting_pairs, "Wetting", keep_wet),
  tau_matrix_long(drying_pairs,  "Drying",  keep_dry)
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying")))

# per-panel clustering order (on 1 - tau, diagonal = 1 only for the distance) --
order_one <- function(df){
  evs <- sort(unique(c(df$a, df$b)))
  if (!reorder_events || length(evs) < 3) return(as.character(evs))
  m <- matrix(0, length(evs), length(evs), dimnames = list(evs, evs))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) m[as.character(df$a[i]), as.character(df$b[i])] <- df$kendall_tau[i]
  diag(m) <- 1
  as.character(evs[hclust(as.dist(1 - m))$order])
}

panels <- tau_long %>% group_split(shed, direction)
plot_one <- function(df){
  ord <- order_one(df)
  df <- df %>% mutate(a = factor(as.character(a), levels = ord),
                      b = factor(as.character(b), levels = ord))
  ggplot(df, aes(a, b, fill = kendall_tau)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey95", high = "#B2182B",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Kendall\ntau") +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = "Event", y = "Event",
         title = paste0(df$shed[1], " — ", df$direction[1])) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
}

fig_tau_hm <- patchwork::wrap_plots(lapply(panels, plot_one), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = "Pairwise Kendall's tau between curated observed event sequences. Diagonal left blank. Red = similar order, blue = reversed, grey = unrelated. Events ordered by clustering within each panel.")
fig_tau_hm
ggsave("figure_event_tau_heatmap.pdf", fig_tau_hm, width = 12, height = 8)
```

MDS ordination
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.5
# MDS ordination of observed event sequences per watershed. Distance = 1 - tau
# between event pairs; nearby points = similarly ordered events. Wetting and
# drying shown together so you can see if the two directions separate.
# Uses wetting_pairs / drying_pairs from earlier.

set.seed(1)

# build a square 1 - tau distance matrix for one shed/direction ---------------
tau_dist <- function(pairs, shed_sel){
  p <- pairs %>% filter(shed == shed_sel)
  evs <- sort(unique(c(p$event_i, p$event_j)))
  if (length(evs) < 3) return(NULL)
  m <- matrix(NA_real_, length(evs), length(evs),
              dimnames = list(as.character(evs), as.character(evs)))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(p))){
    a <- as.character(p$event_i[i]); b <- as.character(p$event_j[i])
    m[a, b] <- m[b, a] <- p$kendall_tau[i]
  }
  diag(m) <- 1
  m[is.na(m)] <- 0                 # unrelated where a pair was undefined
  as.dist(1 - m)                   # dissimilarity in [0, 2]
}

mds_one <- function(pairs, shed_sel, direction){
  d <- tau_dist(pairs, shed_sel)
  if (is.null(d)) return(tibble())
  pts <- as.data.frame(cmdscale(d, k = 2))
  names(pts) <- c("MDS1", "MDS2")
  pts$event <- attr(d, "Labels")
  pts$shed <- shed_sel; pts$direction <- direction
  pts
}

mds_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(c("W3", "FB", "ZZ"), function(s) mds_one(wetting_pairs, s, "Wetting")),
  lapply(c("W3", "FB", "ZZ"), function(s) mds_one(drying_pairs,  s, "Drying"))
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying")))

dir_cols <- c("Wetting" = "#93C2F1", "Drying" = "#FFA400")

fig_mds <- ggplot(mds_df, aes(MDS1, MDS2, color = direction)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = event), size = 2.6, show.legend = FALSE,
                           max.overlaps = 20, seed = 1) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = direction), type = "norm", linewidth = 0.4,
               alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +   # drop if too few points
  facet_wrap(~ shed, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = dir_cols, name = "") +
  labs(x = "MDS axis 1", y = "MDS axis 2",
       title = "Event sequence ordination (distance = 1 - Kendall's tau)",
       subtitle = "Nearby events have similar order; wetting vs. drying separation shows directional structure") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

fig_mds
ggsave("figure_event_tau_mds.pdf", fig_mds, width = 11, height = 4.5)
```

All events, no curation. FInal figure?
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
# Event x event pairwise Kendall's tau over ALL events, recomputed directly from
# the ds_* direction sequences (NOT from the curated wetting_pairs/drying_pairs).
reorder_events <- FALSE

event_rank_list <- function(dir_long){
  dir_long %>% group_by(event_id) %>% mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    { split(select(., sensor_id, rank), .$event_id) }
}

# all-pairs tau within one shed/direction, no event filtering -----------------
pairwise_all <- function(dir_long, shed, min_shared = 3){
  rl <- event_rank_list(dir_long)
  evs <- names(rl)
  if (length(evs) < 2) return(tibble())
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (cc in combn(evs, 2, simplify = FALSE)){
    m <- inner_join(rl[[cc[1]]], rl[[cc[2]]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_i", "_j"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    kt <- suppressWarnings(cor(m$rank_i, m$rank_j, method = "kendall"))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(shed = shed,
                                     event_i = as.integer(cc[1]),
                                     event_j = as.integer(cc[2]),
                                     kendall_tau = kt)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

wetting_all <- bind_rows(
  pairwise_all(ds_w3$wetting, "W3"),
  pairwise_all(ds_fb$wetting, "FB"),
  pairwise_all(ds_zz$wetting, "ZZ"))
drying_all <- bind_rows(
  pairwise_all(ds_w3$drying, "W3"),
  pairwise_all(ds_fb$drying, "FB"),
  pairwise_all(ds_zz$drying, "ZZ"))

# long, symmetric, no diagonal -----------------------------------------------
tau_matrix_long <- function(pairs, direction){
  pairs %>%
    { bind_rows(transmute(., shed, a = event_i, b = event_j, kendall_tau),
                transmute(., shed, a = event_j, b = event_i, kendall_tau)) } %>%
    mutate(direction = direction)
}
tau_long <- bind_rows(
  tau_matrix_long(wetting_all, "Wetting"),
  tau_matrix_long(drying_all,  "Drying")
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Wetting", "Drying")))

order_one <- function(df){
  evs <- sort(unique(c(df$a, df$b)))
  if (!reorder_events || length(evs) < 3) return(as.character(evs))
  m <- matrix(0, length(evs), length(evs), dimnames = list(evs, evs))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) m[as.character(df$a[i]), as.character(df$b[i])] <- df$kendall_tau[i]
  diag(m) <- 1
  as.character(evs[hclust(as.dist(1 - m))$order])
}

panels <- tau_long %>% group_split(shed, direction)
plot_one <- function(df){
  ord <- order_one(df)
  df <- df %>% mutate(a = factor(as.character(a), levels = ord),
                      b = factor(as.character(b), levels = ord))
  ggplot(df, aes(a, b, fill = kendall_tau)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey95", high = "#B2182B",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Kendall\ntau") +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = "Event", y = "Event", title = paste0(df$shed[1], " — ", df$direction[1])) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
}

figure1 <- patchwork::wrap_plots(lapply(panels, plot_one), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = "Pairwise Kendall's tau between ALL observed event sequences (recomputed from ds_*). Diagonal blank. Red = similar order, blue = reversed, grey = unrelated. Events clustered within each panel.")
figure1
ggsave("figure1_event_tau_heatmap.pdf", figure1, width = 12, height = 8)
```

Table with all events
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Combined consistency table over the FULL set of observed sequences.
# Recomputes the three tau inputs from ds_* (no curation / no >=5-cycling filter),
# then applies the same summaries as before.

event_rank_list <- function(dir_long){
  dir_long %>% group_by(event_id) %>% mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    { split(select(., sensor_id, rank), .$event_id) }
}

# --- (1,2) all-pairs within-direction tau, all events -----------------------
pairwise_all <- function(dir_long, shed, min_shared = 3){
  rl <- event_rank_list(dir_long); evs <- names(rl)
  if (length(evs) < 2) return(tibble())
  out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (cc in combn(evs, 2, simplify = FALSE)){
    m <- inner_join(rl[[cc[1]]], rl[[cc[2]]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_i","_j"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_i, m$rank_j, method = "kendall"))
    out[[length(out)+1]] <- tibble(shed = shed,
                                   event_i = as.integer(cc[1]), event_j = as.integer(cc[2]),
                                   kendall_tau = unname(ct$estimate), tau_p = ct$p.value)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}
wetting_pairs_full <- bind_rows(pairwise_all(ds_w3$wetting,"W3"),
                                pairwise_all(ds_fb$wetting,"FB"),
                                pairwise_all(ds_zz$wetting,"ZZ"))
drying_pairs_full  <- bind_rows(pairwise_all(ds_w3$drying,"W3"),
                                pairwise_all(ds_fb$drying,"FB"),
                                pairwise_all(ds_zz$drying,"ZZ"))

# --- (3) within-event wetting-vs-drying tau, all events ---------------------
wet_dry_all <- function(wet_long, dry_long, shed, min_shared = 3){
  wl <- event_rank_list(wet_long); dl <- event_rank_list(dry_long)
  evs <- intersect(names(wl), names(dl)); out <- vector("list", 0)
  for (e in evs){
    m <- inner_join(wl[[e]], dl[[e]], by = "sensor_id", suffix = c("_wet","_dry"))
    if (nrow(m) < min_shared) next
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(m$rank_wet, m$rank_dry, method = "kendall"))
    out[[length(out)+1]] <- tibble(shed = shed, event_id = as.integer(e),
                                   kendall_tau = unname(ct$estimate), tau_p = ct$p.value)
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}
wet_dry_events_full <- bind_rows(
  wet_dry_all(ds_w3$wetting, ds_w3$drying, "W3"),
  wet_dry_all(ds_fb$wetting, ds_fb$drying, "FB"),
  wet_dry_all(ds_zz$wetting, ds_zz$drying, "ZZ"))

# --- summaries (unchanged logic) --------------------------------------------
summ_consistency <- function(df, label){
  df %>% group_by(shed) %>%
    summarise(n = n(),
              mean_tau = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_tau   = sd(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
              frac_sig = mean(tau_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
              wilcox_p = NA_real_, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(comparison = label)
}
wet_dry_wilcox <- wet_dry_events_full %>%
  group_by(shed) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_tau = mean(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_tau   = sd(kendall_tau, na.rm = TRUE),
            frac_sig = NA_real_,
            wilcox_p = tryCatch(wilcox.test(kendall_tau, mu = 0)$p.value,
                                error = function(e) NA_real_),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Wetting vs drying (within event)")

consistency <- bind_rows(
  summ_consistency(wetting_pairs_full, "Wetting consistency (across events)"),
  summ_consistency(drying_pairs_full,  "Drying consistency (across events)"),
  wet_dry_wilcox
) %>%
  mutate(shed = factor(shed, levels = c("W3", "FB", "ZZ")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c(
           "Wetting consistency (across events)",
           "Drying consistency (across events)",
           "Wetting vs drying (within event)"))) %>%
  mutate(interpretation = case_when(
    comparison != "Wetting vs drying (within event)" & mean_tau >= 0.5 ~ "Highly consistent",
    comparison != "Wetting vs drying (within event)" & mean_tau >= 0.3 ~ "Moderately consistent",
    comparison != "Wetting vs drying (within event)"                   ~ "Weakly consistent",
    mean_tau <= -0.3 & wilcox_p < 0.05 ~ "Significantly reversed",
    mean_tau <    0  & wilcox_p < 0.05 ~ "Reversed (weak but sig.)",
    wilcox_p >= 0.05 | is.na(wilcox_p) ~ "No sig. difference",
    TRUE ~ "Same order both directions")) %>%
  arrange(shed, comparison) %>%
  select(shed, comparison, n, mean_tau, sd_tau, frac_sig, wilcox_p, interpretation)

knitr::kable(
  consistency %>%
    mutate(across(c(mean_tau, sd_tau, frac_sig), ~ round(.x, 3)),
           wilcox_p = ifelse(is.na(wilcox_p), "—",
                             format.pval(wilcox_p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3))),
  col.names = c("Watershed", "Comparison", "n", "Mean tau", "SD tau",
                "Frac. p<0.05", "Wilcoxon p", "Interpretation"),
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l"),
  caption = "Combined sequence analysis over ALL observed events (no curation). Rows 1-2: internal consistency of wetting and drying sequences across events (Frac. p<0.05 = share of event pairs with significant positive tau). Row 3: within-event wetting-vs-drying order, one-sample Wilcoxon signed-rank test (H0: median tau = 0); negative mean tau = drying reverses wetting. n = event pairs (rows 1-2) or events (row 3).")
```
